info.title: Queue OpenAPI for blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/keyframes-to-video
info.description: FLUX 3 Max keyframes to video from Black Forest Labs. Input: keyframes (list of image_url + frame_index, at most duration x fps) and a prompt describing how the video moves between them. Options: duration 5-20 seconds (default 5), aspect_ratio (auto, 21:9, 2:1, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16; default auto), generate_audio (default true), reasoning_level low or high (default high, the model expands your prompt), seed. Output: 720p video with native audio. Billed per second of generated video.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate a video through keyframe images pinned to frame positions.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed to use for the generation. Random when not provided.

keyframes.title: Keyframes
keyframes.description: Keyframe images pinned to frame positions in the generated video. Up to 10 keyframes with unique `frame_index` values.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` uses 16:9 for text prompts and follows the first image otherwise.

reasoning_level.title: Reasoning Level
reasoning_level.description: How much effort the harness spends reasoning about the given prompt. Higher reasoning effort means slower generation time.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: The woman picks up a brown felt fedora, lifts it onto her head with both hands and adjusts the brim, smiling at the camera. Soft studio light against a plain gray wall.
prompt.description: The text prompt describing how the video moves between keyframes.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed used for the generation.

timings.description: `inference`: seconds the model spent denoising the video. Excludes prompt expansion, decoding and upload.
timings.title: Timings

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of the keyframe image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).

frame_index.title: Frame Index
frame_index.description: Frame position of this keyframe in the generated 24 fps video. Must be unique and at most `duration * 24`.

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: The number of frames in the video

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
